set.body: Ship the #381/#382/#383 fixes: last_pushed_key is the create-vs-update fallback after a lost link, worklog dedupe collapses marker copies, and merge=ours plus a regenerating pre-merge-commit keeps roadmap/IA out of the conflict. Cut v0.24.8 once the PR is green.
set.title: Release v0.24.8: stop sync dupes and generated-file merge fights

set.body: create-vs-update is decided only by folded external.key. A checkout that drops an uncommitted link leaves last_pushed_key behind, is_dirty() forces the item into scope, and the next sync creates. Remembered key updates the original; unlink clears last_pushed_* so a deliberate unlink still files fresh. Closes #382.
set.title: Sync must not mint a second ticket after git throws the link away

set.body: Once #382 has minted extras, fold LWW keeps one key so external_owners cannot see one-item-many-keys. Detect by marker ULID, classify agreed vs mixed-state conflicts, collapse only agreed groups (close losers with a pointer, re-link the survivor). Title twins are low-confidence and never auto-collapsed. Default is dry-run. Closes #383.
set.title: worklog dedupe: collapse agreed marker copies, report conflicts

set.body: todo.jsonl union-merges; docs/roadmap.md and docs/.index do not, so two branches that each add a work item always conflict on a file nobody edited by hand. Built-in merge=ours on those paths plus regenerate-and-git-add in pre-merge-commit before the freshness gate. Closes #381.
set.title: Generated roadmap and IA must merge without a conflict

set.resolution: remembered_key updates the original; unlink clears last_pushed_* so a deliberate unlink still files fresh.
worklog dedupe groups by marker, default dry-run, --collapse-agreed closes extras with a pointer.
merge=ours on generated paths plus pre-merge-commit regenerate-and-stage.
